title: Fluid Power Systems Engineering: Mechanical and Hydraulic Systems
description: A hands-on, open fluid power curriculum built around a single running machine — a precision hydraulic lift platform — spanning 11 modules and 52 lessons, from cylinders, pumps, and valves through electrohydraulic control, modeling and simulation, closed-loop control, and a live digital twin. Each lesson pairs physical intuition with a labelled diagram, an interactive demonstration, a worked example, and a short coding exercise.
